verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only outbound vendor due diligence: Sprinto sends security questionnaires to vendors and lets admins upload questionnaire templates for that purpose. Nothing shows it importing customer-sent SIG, CAIQ, portal or spreadsheet questionnaires and exporting answers in the customer's original format. Vendor-assessment questionnaires are an adjacent feature, not this sales-side capability.

support.subject: As a sales lead, questionnaires arrive in every shape — SIG, CAIQ, portals, spreadsheets — and the platform imports and exports them in the format the customer sent
